entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We ain't gonna be able to get[n]through like this. Let's try and[n]find a different way in.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nope, no way this'll work...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think it's time to pop out that[n]keycard from earlier?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold up! Think we can use that[n]keycard to open the door?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's try it!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, we won't be able to use it if it's[n]being controlled somewhere else...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is that... an elevator?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, it has to be the one they're[n]controlling externally. So this is[n]right above it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So what, this is the control room[n]or something? What's the point of[n]comin' here?
We can get on the elevator.
We can go to the basement.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Perceptive as usual, Joker.[n]We should be able to ride[n]on top of the elevator.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see. We sneak atop it, then[n]wait for it to move on its own.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It does sound like that plan will[n]take us further down.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, let's get on there!

entries.en: That's not the way. Just get in towards[n]the back!

entries.speaker: Security Guard

entries.en: Hey, we don't got time to be[n]headin' back right now!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go for the exit! Hurry!

entries.speaker: Morgana
